items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1959-09-01
items.q: I never seen him anymore but here.

ctx.x: Was this the guy from New York City? Yeah I think he was. Did you know him later in New York? I don't know.
I never seen him anymore but here.
Jimmy Johnson. What did he look like? What did he look like Jimmy? Well he was a dark slender fellow.
